content: MapLibre GL JS v6.0.0 (npm, ES-modules-only) is the open-source Mapbox-GL-JS fork; fully self-hostable with zero runtime network calls if you bundle your own style.json, sprites, glyphs, and vector tiles. PMTiles (single-file tile archive, v4.4.1 npm client) + tileserver-gl let you ship one static .pmtiles file (a low-zoom-only world basemap is a few MB, not the ~80GB full-planet dataset) served via HTTP range requests from the app's own static server -- no external tile CDN needed.
